Aktive Stempel-Rufnummern: :lines. Anruf: Active stamp numbers: :lines. Calls to them become clock-in/out stamps on import; the caller number acts as the badge.
Bereit — CSV-Upload-Betrieb (kein Telefo: Ready — CSV upload mode (no phone report mail intake connected).
Bereit — Telefonbericht-Mail-Intake verb: Ready — phone report mail intake connected.
Eigene Rufnummer mit Wechsel-Logik (offe: Own line with toggle logic (open stamp → clock out, otherwise clock in). The call is not answered — the caller number acts as the badge; maintain the mapping on the FRITZ!Box page.
Eigene Rufnummer, deren Anrufe als Gehen: Own line whose calls count as clock-out stamps. Empty = off.
Eigene Rufnummer, deren Anrufe als Komme: Own line whose calls count as clock-in stamps (exactly as shown in the call list). Empty = off.
Endet ein Anruf höchstens so viele Minut: If a call ends at most this many minutes before a booked remote support time of the same customer, it is merged into it (the start is pulled forward) instead of being booked twice.
FRITZ!Box → Telefonie → Anrufe → Sichern: FRITZ!Box → Telephony → Calls → Save (CSV). Numbers of known customers book automatically; calls that overlap a booked remote support time of the same customer or precede it by up to :lead minutes are merged into the existing entry. Calls under :min minutes and missed calls are filtered out; unknown numbers end up in the mapping inbox.
FRITZ!Box-Import: :created gebucht, :lin: FRITZ!Box import: :created booked, :linked merged, :stamped stamped, :pending open (inbox), :skipped skipped, :ignored filtered out, :locked locked.
Importiert die FRITZ!Box-Anrufliste (CSV: Imports the FRITZ!Box call list (CSV or phone report via email) and books calls as time entries — merging them into overlapping remote support times.
Kein buchbarer Benutzer in der Organisat: No bookable user in the organization.
Keine Stempel-Rufnummer konfiguriert — i: No stamp number configured — set an own line for clock-in/out in the plugin settings. The call is not answered; the caller number acts as the badge.
Keine externe Kontaktquelle verbunden. L: No external contact source is connected. Local customers and end customers will still be matched.
Konfigurierter Standard-Benutzer existie: The configured default user no longer exists in this organization.
Kürzere Gespräche werden übersprungen (R: Shorter calls are skipped (callback requests, misdials). Missed calls are never imported.
Optional, kommagetrennt. Nur Anrufe über: Optional, comma-separated. Only calls via these own numbers are imported (e.g. the business line); empty = all.
Rufnummer konnte nicht normalisiert werd: Phone number could not be normalized.
Telefonate aus der FRITZ!Box-Anrufliste: Import calls from the FRITZ!Box call list as time entries.
Unbekannte Rufnummern mit aktiv verbunde: Match unknown phone numbers against actively connected contact directories such as Lexoffice and Microsoft 365.
Wenn aus, werden importierte Telefonate: If off, imported calls are never marked as billable.
Zum Zuordnen einen Kunden oder Endkunden: Select a customer or end customer to assign.
Ältere FRITZ!OS-Versionen exportieren au: Older FRITZ!OS versions export outgoing calls as type 3, newer ones as type 4 (type 3 = rejected). Enable only if the list comes from an old firmware.
